faq.q: What are the group size limits for yacht charters in Marbella 2031?
faq.a: Group size limits vary by boat, from 5 passengers (e.g., Dubhe or Mariah SX21) up to 12 passengers (e.g., Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, Canados 86). Always check the specific boat's capacity before booking. All our charters depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Can I charter a boat for more than 12 people in Marbella?
faq.a: No, our fleet maximum is 12 passengers per boat. This includes all guests onboard. For larger groups, you would need to charter multiple boats. Contact us via WhatsApp for custom multi-boat arrangements.

faq.q: Are children counted in the group size limit?
faq.a: Yes, children of all ages count toward the maximum passenger capacity. For example, on a 12-pax boat, that includes infants, children, and adults. Life jackets are provided for all ages.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours (Tier A) or €4,719 for 4 hours (Tier B with free jet ski).

faq.q: Which boat is best for a group of 10 adults?
faq.a: For 10 adults, consider the Azimut 39 (11 pax), Pershing 46 (10 pax), Lagoon 380 (10 pax), or Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax). All depart from Puerto Banús. Each offers different layouts and amenities.

faq.q: Do I need a license to charter a yacht in Marbella?
faq.a: No, you do not need a license. Every charter includes a licensed skipper who handles navigation. You and your group can relax and enjoy the coast. All departures are from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What happens if my group is smaller than the boat's maximum capacity?
faq.a: That's fine. You pay the same charter price regardless of group size (up to the boat's limit). Smaller groups often enjoy more space and privacy. For example, a couple can charter a 12-pax boat for a private experience.

faq.q: Can I add extra passengers beyond the boat's capacity?
faq.a: No, safety regulations strictly limit passenger numbers. Exceeding capacity is illegal and unsafe. We enforce these limits on every charter. If you have a larger group, consider booking two boats.

data.body_html:
Planning a group outing on the Costa del Sol? Understanding Marbella yacht charter group size limits 2031 is essential before you book. Each boat in our fleet carries between 5 and 12 passengers, with all charters departing from Puerto Banús. Prices start at €749 for a 2-hour trip on a Tier A boat (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) and go up to €4,719 for a 4-hour charter on a Tier B boat (Mangusta 80) which includes a free jet ski. Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT — no hidden fees. This guide covers capacity rules, boat options, and what to expect for your group in 2031.

Why Group Size Limits Matter for Marbella Yacht Charters

Group size limits are set by maritime safety regulations and the boat's official capacity certificate. Overloading a vessel is illegal and dangerous. Our fleet complies strictly with these limits, so you can enjoy your day with peace of mind. Whether you're a couple celebrating an anniversary or a group of 12 friends, there's a boat that fits your needs. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT — no surprises.

Here's a breakdown of passenger limits for our fleet. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Pricing Based on Group Size

Our pricing is per boat, not per person. This means you pay a fixed rate regardless of how many guests you bring (up to the boat's limit). For smaller groups, this often works out cheaper per person. For larger groups, it's excellent value. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80 variants) are €4,719 minimum for 4 hours and include a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request — contact us via WhatsApp for a quote. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT.

Best Boats for Different Group Sizes

Small groups (5–6 guests): Dubhe (5 pax), Mariah SX21 (5 pax), Red Tide (6 pax), Speedboat (6 pax). Ideal for intimate trips along the coast to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

Medium groups (7–10 guests): Astondoa 40 (9 pax), Bandido (8 pax), Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax), Lagoon 380 (10 pax), Pershing 46 (10 pax). Perfect for a day trip to Cabopino or Estepona.

Large groups (11–12 guests): Azimut 39 (11 pax), Mangusta 80 (12 pax), Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax), Canados 86 (12 pax), Ferretti 94 (12 pax), K80 (12 pax), Maiora 26m (12 pax). Great for parties, celebrations, or corporate events.

What to Expect on Your Charter

Every charter includes a licensed skipper who knows the best spots along the Marbella coastline. You'll depart from Puerto Banús, pass the Golden Mile, and can head toward Sotogrande or the scenic coves near Estepona. Onboard, you'll find water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Fuel and insurance are covered. The skipper handles navigation and safety, so you can relax.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the group size limits for yacht charters in Marbella 2031?

Group size limits vary by boat, from 5 passengers (e.g., Dubhe or Mariah SX21) up to 12 passengers (e.g., Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, Canados 86). Always check the specific boat's capacity before booking. All our charters depart from Puerto Banús.

Can I charter a boat for more than 12 people in Marbella?

No, our fleet maximum is 12 passengers per boat. This includes all guests onboard. For larger groups, you would need to charter multiple boats. Contact us via WhatsApp for custom multi-boat arrangements.

Are children counted in the group size limit?

Yes, children of all ages count toward the maximum passenger capacity. For example, on a 12-pax boat, that includes infants, children, and adults. Life jackets are provided for all ages.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours (Tier A) or €4,719 for 4 hours (Tier B with free jet ski).

Which boat is best for a group of 10 adults?

For 10 adults, consider the Azimut 39 (11 pax), Pershing 46 (10 pax), Lagoon 380 (10 pax), or Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax). All depart from Puerto Banús. Each offers different layouts and amenities.

Do I need a license to charter a yacht in Marbella?

No, you do not need a license. Every charter includes a licensed skipper who handles navigation. You and your group can relax and enjoy the coast. All departures are from Puerto Banús.

What happens if my group is smaller than the boat's maximum capacity?

That's fine. You pay the same charter price regardless of group size (up to the boat's limit). Smaller groups often enjoy more space and privacy. For example, a couple can charter a 12-pax boat for a private experience.

Can I add extra passengers beyond the boat's capacity?

No, safety regulations strictly limit passenger numbers. Exceeding capacity is illegal and unsafe. We enforce these limits on every charter. If you have a larger group, consider booking two boats.
